_note: Gears, dispatch tables, and overrides. Change gears here, never in SKILL.md or the READMEs.

pipeline.authority: stage and verdict live in the state file; artifacts are evidence; on conflict trust the file and set state_mismatch

review_semantics.review_rounds: first-pass independent reviews; in max the 2nd round is adversarial-only
review_semantics.rework_cap_action: escalate to G1 on the 3rd rework

layers.superpowers: process and discipline: how to move (loop, ledger, evidence, finish)
layers.mattpocock: criteria and vocabulary: what good means (seams, anti-patterns, two-axis review, deep modules, glossary)

tie_break: test loop: superpowers test-driven-development; test quality: mattpocock tdd
refactoring belongs to review, not the red-green loop (mattpocock wins this conflict)
PASS/FAIL comes from mattpocock code-review (Standards + Spec); ponytail-review may only add minimalism findings and must not change the AC verdict
debugging: first 3 rounds systematic-debugging; on BLOCKED escalate to diagnosing-bugs
never dispatch ask-matt or using-superpowers; the current stage wins

attributes.cross_module: crosses >= 2 modules or changes a public interface
attributes.parallel: >= 3 independent modules that can land separately
attributes.legacy: undocumented old code with unclear call graph
attributes.terminology: mixed synonyms, or money / time / permission boundaries
attributes.spike: the approach itself is uncertain, not just the implementation
attributes.hard_bug: perf regression or hard-to-reproduce defect (only observable at G3)

low.notes: G1+G2 merged in one pass; tdd supplies criteria only, no full loop; ponytail capped at full

high.notes: tdd gives seams and criteria, test-driven-development runs the loop; G4 must be a fresh session

max.notes: worktree isolation; G4 two rounds (round 2 adversarial only); diagnosing-bugs reserved for BLOCKED

ui.rule: AC must state a page-level action

terminology.rule: glossary with definition and banned synonyms

spike.rule: throwaway prototype, write the answer into plan

dispatch_rules.attributes_set_at_g0: initial set only; additions allowed at any gate
dispatch_rules.escalation_rule: coding-skill-arbiter may only send tasks that G0 accepts: max_triggers, public interface change, untested target module, >=4 files, or an explicit user request

host_config_rule: Read the first path that exists, then take its hosts[active] entry. The first entry is an optional git-ignored override; the last entry is tracked, so a fresh clone always has a working config.

roles.design: strongest reasoning: writes interfaces, seams and failure paths in one pass
roles.code: cheapest flat-rate model: translates the plan into diffs, makes no design calls
roles.review: a different model, ideally a different family, and never weaker than code: reads diff + spec, hunts counterexamples

roles_note: No model ids are committed here: the three roles are the contract, the ids are per host. At G0 read host_config (default config/host.local.json, git-ignored) or resolve against the host catalog, then write the ids into .pipeline.json.models.
model_note: If host_config is absent, resolve design/code/review at G0 from the host's own catalog. If the host offers no second model, set models.review_degraded and follow SKILL.md G4.
est_note: Cost is expressed as a tier only (low / medium / high). Absolute figures, if any, stay in the git-ignored host config.
